question: Why must a nurse closely monitor serum electrolytes in a patient undergoing continuous gastric suctioning?

options.B: Loss of gastric secretions rich in hydrogen and chloride ions can cause metabolic alkalosis
options.C: Electrolytes shift rapidly due to lack of physical exercise

question: Why are anticoagulants frequently prescribed alongside rate-control medications for patients with chronic atrial fibrillation?
